mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and a rise in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a weakening consumer sector, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when the interaction (RSAFS decline and UNRATE rise) occurs but SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, rising federal funds rates compress equity valuations through higher discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing activity and corporate profitability, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO is rising, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1200.0 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the housing market that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when HOUST < 1200.0, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.5%) signals labor market tightness that may lead to inflationary pressures and central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansions with UNRATE < 4.5%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a monetary tightening that is suppressing economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when the interaction (FEDFUNDS rise and INDPRO decline) occurs but SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over a 3-year window.
